title: Secrets To A Successful Marriage
description: A comprehensive course on marriage in Islam covering preparation, rights, responsibilities, and building a successful marriage from an authentic Salafi perspective. Based on the lectures of Ustadh AbdulRahman Hassan from AMAU Academy, this course covers the essential principles of a righteous marriage according to the Quran and Sunnah.
short_description: Learn the secrets to a successful Islamic marriage from authentic Salafi sources

modules.title: Foundations of Marriage in Islam
modules.description: Understanding the importance and purpose of marriage in Islam

lessons.title: 3 Keys to a Successful Muslim Marriage
lessons.content: Ustadh Abdulrahman Hassan breaks down the three essential pillars of a lasting marriage in this practical and relationship-saving lecture.

lessons.title: A Guide to Islamic Marriage - Part 1
lessons.content: Part 1 of a comprehensive guide to Islamic marriage covering the foundations and principles of a righteous marriage.

lessons.title: The Importance of Marriage in Islam
lessons.content: Understanding the religious significance and spiritual benefits of marriage according to the Quran and Sunnah.

lessons.title: Qualities of a Righteous Spouse
lessons.content: What to look for in a spouse according to the Prophet's ﷺ guidance and the characteristics of a righteous partner.

modules.title: Rights and Responsibilities
modules.description: Understanding the mutual rights and responsibilities in an Islamic marriage

lessons.title: Rights of the Husband
lessons.content: The rights of the husband in Islam according to the Quran and Sunnah, and how they should be fulfilled.

lessons.title: Rights of the Wife
lessons.content: The rights of the wife in Islam and how the Prophet ﷺ honored and respected his wives.

lessons.title: Financial Responsibilities in Marriage
lessons.content: Understanding the financial obligations of both spouses including mahr, nafaqah, and shared expenses.

lessons.title: Mutual Respect and Honor
lessons.content: How to establish mutual respect and honor in marriage based on the Prophetic example.

modules.title: Building a Successful Marriage
modules.description: Practical advice for maintaining and strengthening the marital bond

lessons.title: Communication in Marriage
lessons.content: The importance of effective communication and active listening in maintaining a healthy marriage.

lessons.title: Love and Mercy in Marriage
lessons.content: Understanding the concept of love (mawaddah) and mercy (rahmah) in marriage as mentioned in the Quran.

lessons.title: Resolving Conflicts Islamicly
lessons.content: Islamic principles for resolving marital conflicts and maintaining harmony in the household.

lessons.title: Building a Righteous Family
lessons.content: How to build a righteous Muslim family and raise children according to Islamic principles.
